$comment: COMPLIANCE CONFIGURATION. Hand-edited governance data, read by sros_acquisition.compliance. It carries the PARAMETERS of the obligations Mission 1.3 recorded -- exact notices, licence allowlists, enumerated exclusions -- so that satisfying a condition is a configuration fact rather than a branch in application code (Mission 1.4 §5, §7). It grants nothing: every entry here describes a restriction, and a source with no entry is denied by the resource gate rather than allowed.

derived_from.note: Every requirement below traces to a document Mission 1.3 retrieved. Nothing here re-reads a platform's terms; adding a requirement means re-opening the review, not editing this file.

sources.evidence_section: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC-BY 4.0); Microdata Research License; License Specified Externally; Custom License

attribution.notes: CC-BY 4.0 permits commercial use provided appropriate credit is given AND changes are indicated. The licence prescribes no exact sentence, so the credit string is configuration; the requirement that changes be indicated is not, which is why MODIFICATION_STATEMENT is supplied per artefact rather than defaulted. The licence identifier is per DATASET -- the same platform distributes CC-BY 4.0 and ODbL data -- so it cannot be a fixed string either.

resource_scope.licence_allowlist_note: Canonical identifiers, matched exactly. A dataset whose licence is recorded in another spelling is denied rather than guessed at, because guessing is how 'License Specified Externally' would become 'probably CC-BY'.
resource_scope.dataset_family_note: The Microdata Library is excluded outright: its licence permits statistical and scientific research only and forbids redistribution without a prior written agreement. A resource whose family is unrecorded is denied -- an unclassified dataset is not a dataset known not to be microdata.

access_restriction.name: indicators-api-only
access_restriction.note: The registry must hold this profile and no other for the restriction to be verifiable. A second profile appearing on this source -- a bulk download, a browser path -- fails the check rather than being ignored.

sources.datasets_note:
The authorised resource set (Mission 1.5 §7). A collector builds its resource descriptor FROM an entry here, never from what a caller claims -- otherwise 'this dataset is CC-BY 4.0' would be an assertion the requester makes about itself, which is the failure mode the whole review model exists to prevent. A resource with no entry has no licence, no dataset family and no content origin, so the resource gate denies it.

DELIBERATELY SMALL, and the reason is recorded rather than assumed. The licence on each entry rests on the Data Catalog statement that CC-BY 4.0 is the DEFAULT licence for datasets the World Bank itself produces and distributes as open data -- not on a per-series licence page, because none was retrieved. Mission 1.3 left exactly this as an open question: 'Confirm per dataset, at collection time, which licence applies.' Until a reviewer closes it, widening this list means re-opening the review, not appending a line.

datasets.name: GDP (current US$)
datasets.basis: A World Development Indicators series compiled by the World Bank from national accounts data. Covered by the Data Catalog default licence for World Bank-produced open data.

data_minimisation.note: Mission 1.3 §14. dataset_licence is in the allowed list because the licence allowlist cannot be evaluated without it.

sources.evidence_section: General principles; Exceptions; How to re-use Eurostat material for commercial purposes; How to cite Eurostat products

attribution.notes: Citation must give the dataset DOI and the access date; both are per-retrieval values and neither can be defaulted. Modifications must be stated with a non-responsibility disclaimer, and the exact disclaimer wording is NOT in the retrieved evidence -- so the disclaimer is required as SUPPLIED text rather than composed here. Inventing the sentence would be the opposite of preserving a required notice exactly.

resource_scope.geography_allowlist_note: EU-27 plus the four EFTA states, deliberately WITHOUT acceding and candidate countries. The copyright notice permits their data for commercial reuse; the set changes over time and the notice does not enumerate it, so the list here is stricter than the terms and never more permissive. Widening it requires re-reading the notice and recording the decision, not editing this array. EU-wide aggregate codes (EU27_2020, EA19) are likewise absent and therefore denied.

enumerated_exclusions.reason: Trade data declared by Liechtenstein and Switzerland from 1995 onwards in the HS, SITC, BEC and NSTR classifications is named by the copyright notice as an exception to free re-use.
Trade data declared by Austria at CN 8-digit level is named by the copyright notice as an exception to free re-use.

resource_scope.third_party_note: The notice excludes material identified as belonging to sources other than Eurostat, and publications whose copyright is partly or wholly third-party.

data_minimisation.note: Mission 1.3 §14. dataset_doi and access_date are allowed because the attribution obligation cannot be met without them; declaring_country because the trade exclusions cannot be evaluated without it.

attribution.notes: The terms prescribe one sentence and require it to appear prominently on the application. It is stored here VERBATIM, including the registered trademark symbol, and rendered unmodified. A paraphrase is a different sentence and does not satisfy the requirement. No SOURCE_CREDIT element is declared: the terms require this notice, and adding a second obligation would be inventing one.

requirements.text: This product uses the FRED® API but is not endorsed or certified by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.

resource_scope.note_marker_note: Matched case-insensitively against the series notes. require_notes is true because a series whose notes were never read is not a series known to be uncopyrighted: the terms say copyrighted series are identifiable BY their notes, so an absent note is an unanswered question, not a clean answer.
resource_scope.third_party_note: The Bank's provision of the API does not override third-party owners' copyrights, and permission for those series must come from the owner. This system cannot record such a permission for itself; doing so is a human act with a document behind it.

data_minimisation.note: Mission 1.3 §14. series_notes is in the allowed list for a specific reason: the copyrighted-series exclusion is evaluated from the notes, so a collector that minimised them away would lose the ability to honour the condition.
